people.imagined: Before first light on the river shore, the cloud-sky still grey. She has ground her ink and is about to paint the morning cloud on a hanging sheet. Someone has stepped in from behind and she pauses with the brush lifted, thinking of a fire talisman she refuses to paint.
people.subject: The moment: in the grey minutes before sunrise on a misty river shore she holds a long brush lifted just off a hanging sheet of pale mulberry paper and turns her head toward the viewer, the brush tip still wet. Face: a small, slight oval face with a pointed chin; fair skin, a little sallow from early rising; very straight low brows; narrow dark-brown eyes with faint shadows beneath; a thin nose; a firm pale mouth; ink-grey stains on her cheek and fingertips. Hair: black, pinned in a tight round knot with a single long ink brush with a jade handle pushed through it like a hairpin, its goat-hair tip stained grey and pointing up and to the left; this brush must be clearly visible; a few fine hairs cling to her neck. Body: slight, narrow-shouldered, very upright. Clothing: the hall-mistress's richest dress: an inner robe of mulberry-grey silk, a middle robe of dawn-gold brocade woven with ink-wash clouds, and a long over-robe of pale dawn-pink gauze with wide sleeves that drift like mist; the three crossed collars are embroidered in grey ink clouds, the cuffs stained grey to the wrist, a jade pendant on a silver-grey sash. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the brush, fingertips slate grey; the left holds the edge of a hanging sheet with loose swirls of grey cloud, no characters. Power: a soft haze of blue-green qi, like damp air, gathers along the brush and rises in slow wisps round her shoulders, with a few pale motes. Background: blurred river mist, dark mulberry silhouettes, a thin line of rose at the horizon, a dry sheet hanging on a line behind her. Light: cool ethereal dawn light from the upper left, a silver rim along her cheek, a warm hint on the brush hand. Expression: patient, severe, tired, resolved.

people.imagined: A reception at the old seat. He has just finished quoting a couplet and is waiting for the effect, one hand lifted in mid-gesture. His robe is a shade too close to the lord's violet. He is smiling at someone he wants something from.
people.subject: The moment: at a reception in a lantern-lit pavilion he lifts one hand in a small flourish after a quotation and smiles warmly and slightly too long at the viewer. Face: handsome, long-jawed and smooth; olive skin; high forehead; arched dark brows; bright dark eyes with fine smile lines; a straight nose; a well-shaped mouth with a practised, even smile and a flicker of watchfulness beneath it; a short trimmed beard-shadow on the chin. Hair: black with two clean silver wings at the temples, combed back and tied in a high knot under a small silver crown with a dark jade pin. Body: tall, straight-backed, elegant. Clothing: an elder's rich dusk-line dress: an inner robe of mulberry-grey silk, a long middle robe of fine dusk-violet silk whose hem is a shade bluer than the lord's violet, and a translucent pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe with wide soft sleeves; collar borders embroidered with ink-wash clouds in silver thread, a thin violet line along the cuffs, a pale grey sash fastened with a small jade toggle and hung with a tassel. Hands and objects: his right hand is raised at shoulder height with two fingers extended; over his left forearm lies a folded silk banner painted with a plain red beam and blue cloud, no writing. Power: a faint blue-green mist curls from the sleeve with a few drifting motes of light, the quiet aura of a Kết Đan elder. Background: blurred warm lantern light and the red of maple leaves through an open doorway. Light: golden lantern-glow on his face with a pale spirit-light rim from behind. Expression: charming, calculating, hungry for favour; a faint scent of sandalwood seems to cling to him.

people.imagined: Dawn again, the three-thousandth identical cloud. She sits at her board with her jaw set and does not look up until the brush is lifted. A thick yellow callus on her finger is what she looks at.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a writing board at dawn she looks up sharply from her work, mouth pressed to a thin line, her brush lifted upright. Face: a hard, bony face with a flat forehead; skin weathered and sallow; a tight mouth with the corners pulled down; deep lines from nose to chin; narrow dark eyes under straight heavy brows; a stubborn square chin. Hair: grey-streaked black, scraped back flat with water and wound into a hard knot with a plain pale-jade pin. Body: lean and stiff, shoulders held high. Clothing: the robes of a Trúc Cơ inner disciple of the dawn line: a mulberry-grey silk robe with a crossed collar buttoned to the throat, a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe with narrow sleeves tied back by silk cords, collar borders embroidered with ink-wash clouds, faint ink at the cuffs and grey ink to the elbow; well kept, nothing loose. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the brush upright; the callus on the first finger, a bright yellow-white lump the size of a pea, is large in the frame; before her on the board lies one finished perfect grey cloud on pale paper, no characters. Power: a faint wash of blue-green qi lies on the sheet and trembles along the brush. Background: a dim dawn-grey wall, a stack of identical grey cloud sheets in tied bundles blurred on a shelf, a narrow high window with a grey sky and a thin line of rose. Light: cool silver-grey spirit-light from the upper left, a thin glowing rim on her bony cheek. Expression: bitter, controlled, unforgiving, the face of a woman on her three-thousandth identical cloud.

people.imagined: Night at the Jade Milk spring among the stone pillars. He is grinding ink, wearing his gloves, and looks up at a sound. The ink in the dish is darker than it should be, and he does not want anyone to see it.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a spring among stone pillars he stops grinding an ink stick and looks sideways toward the viewer with wary, slightly widened eyes. Face: pale and narrow, almost grey-white, like skin kept from the sun; a long thin nose; a thin mouth held shut; hollow cheeks; dark-ringed very dark brown eyes; thin black eyebrows; faint black veins visible at the temple. Hair: black, tied low at the nape with a grey silk ribbon, loose strands at the sides. Body: stooped, narrow-shouldered, held tight, the neck long and pale. Clothing: a Trúc Cơ inner disciple's mulberry-grey silk robe with a high crossed collar and a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe that falls in dim folds, ink-wash clouds embroidered on the collar; both hands in thin black silk gloves that reach the sleeves, the gloves lightly stained, the cuffs tucked inside them with a faint dark stain seeping through at the left wrist. Hands and objects: he holds a black ink stick over a shallow stone dish of very dark, glossy ink from which a faint dark thread of mist lifts. Power: a thin black-violet thread of qi curls off the ink and coils round his gloved fingers, the shadow-tint of his hidden Yin nature. Background: blurred wet grey limestone pillars and a dim spring pool lit by drifting motes. Light: cold pale blue moonlight from the upper left, the ink dish shining with a dull violet gleam. Expression: wary, guarded, ashamed, a man who wants very much to be left alone and knows he will not be.

people.imagined: At the paper mill, mid-sneeze. White pulp dust floats in the light. He is holding up a fresh wet sheet to the window, the sneeze coming for the third time.
people.subject: The moment: at his paper mill he holds a thin sheet up to the window light with both hands and is caught the instant before a sneeze, nose scrunched, eyes squeezed shut. Face: round, full-cheeked and ruddy; a broad nose and a wide mouth; thick brows; the whole face and hair dusted white with fine paper pulp, the eyelashes and brows white. Hair: grey-black, cropped short, white with dust. Body: broad, sturdy and short, strong forearms. Clothing: a Trúc Cơ inner disciple's mulberry-grey silk robe with a crossed collar and ink-cloud borders, a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe rolled to the elbow so it will not catch the vats, a sash of grey silk; the whole dress floury with white pulp from collar to knee; instead of an apron, a long cracked-lacquer waist-cloth of grey silk over the front. Hands and objects: both hands lift a pale translucent sheet of mulberry paper, the window light shining through its fibres. Power: a very faint green warmth in the paper and a drift of pale green motes mixed with the floating pulp dust. Background: blurred wooden vats and drying racks, steam, white sparkles of dust in the sunbeams. Light: bright misty morning light from the upper left, dust glittering like spirit-motes, a soft glow through the sheet onto his face. Expression: comic, kind, about to sneeze, his eyes wet from the dust and his whole round face scrunched.

people.imagined: Midday at her stall. A customer has paused to haggle, and she has switched her laugh on. Her eyes are not laughing. Six rings flash on her counting hand.
people.subject: The moment: behind a market stall at midday she laughs warmly with her mouth wide while her eyes, cold and measuring, study a customer's face. Face: round, pretty, plump-cheeked with a double chin; powdered pale skin; carefully painted red lips; arched drawn brows; dark eyes sharp and level while the mouth smiles; a small beauty mark under the right eye. Hair: glossy black, in a high coil with two small gilt combs and a sprig of artificial peach blossom. Body: plump, comfortable, leaning forward over a counter. Clothing: a Trúc Cơ inner disciple's dress cut from the best silk: a mulberry-grey robe with a violet hem peeking beneath, a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe, a coral-coloured sash tied in a flat bow with a jade tassel; collar and sleeve edges embroidered with tiny gold ink-clouds. Hands and objects: her right hand, raised near her face, wears six rings (a thin silver one, two jade ones on the thumb, a red coral one, a brass one and a plain gold one) flashing as she gestures; her left hand lays a sheet of blank talisman paper with a red-brown stamp on the counter. Power: a faint warm green sparkle drifts about her rings. Background: blurred market awning of red cloth with hanging yellow paper sheets in a soft lantern-lit crowd. Light: warm bright afternoon light from the upper left with a pearly glow on her powdered cheek. Expression: a salesperson's laugh like a lamp switched on, the eyes cool and fixed on the customer's rings and boots.

people.imagined: Dawn on a brook bank in spring. She is painting a name on a pink petal and humming, tongue between her teeth. She doesn't notice the viewer yet.
people.subject: The moment: on a spring brook bank at dawn she bends over a tiny task, humming, and glances up at the viewer with a startled smile. Face: round, soft and freckled; rosy cheeks; wide dark-brown eyes with long lashes; a small button nose; a gap between her front teeth; no wrinkle. Hair: black, in two short buns tied with pink silk thread, peach petals tucked in them. Body: small and sturdy, leaning forward on her knees, shoulders rounded and hands small with short stubby fingers. Clothing: a Luyện Khí disciple's simple graceful dress, new and clean: a mulberry-grey silk robe with a crossed collar, a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe with the sleeves pushed up and its cuffs stained pink on the left and yellow on the right with petal juice, a pale-green silk cord at the waist, a damp hem from the bank. Hands and objects: her fingertips pinch a pink petal and a very fine brush writes a tiny grey swirl on it; a small heap of pink and white petals lies on a flat stone. Power: a faint pale-green glimmer runs along the petal and a few green motes rise like pollen. Background: a blurred green bank, a clear brook with floating petals, soft peach blossoms and a drifting dawn mist. Light: soft rosy spirit-light of early morning from the upper left, a gentle shimmer on her cheeks. Expression: bright, shy and delighted, a hum still on her lips, her face open and unguarded as if the viewer were an old friend.

people.imagined: In the courtyard, a letter just sent home. He is straightening his brush case again because someone looked at it. He is anxious that his cousin will come and outshine him.
people.subject: The moment: in a courtyard he stands holding a brush case against his chest with both hands, straightening it by a hair as someone glances at it, and looks anxiously at the viewer. Face: a thin, handsome, well-bred young face; pale skin; an anxious dent between the brows; smooth dark eyes with a defensive stare; a narrow nose; a mouth held in a polite half-smile; a small nick on the chin. Hair: black, in a neat high knot with a plain pale-jade pin, one strand escaping. Body: tall, thin, tense shoulders. Clothing: a Luyện Khí outer disciple's simple graceful dress with a family touch: a mulberry-grey silk outer robe with a crossed collar and a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe, and beneath it a good Phong Lâm family coat of blue-grey silk, clearly let out at the hem, a lighter band showing where it was lowered; a plain grey sash. Hands and objects: a lacquered brush case, black with a single gold line running round the lid, held in both hands, his thumbs worrying the edge. Background: a blurred grey courtyard wall with a round moon window, a stone lantern and the red of maples under drifting mist. Light: soft cool moon-pale light from the upper left with a faint glow on his brow. Expression: polite, stiff and worried; he holds the smile he has practised but his eyes keep sliding toward the brush case.

people.imagined: On the dock at dusk, he is carrying a jar of dark ink down from the spring, hands hidden in his sleeves. A stern lamp glows on a boat behind him. He is thinking of the winter storm.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a harbour jetty he stands with both hands pulled up inside his sleeves and looks down and sideways at the viewer; behind him a boat's stern lamp has just been lit. Face: a young fisher boy's face, salt-burnt dark brown and weathered; chapped lips; narrow black eyes; a straight nose; short thick brows; cheeks windburnt red. Hair: black and salt-stiff, cut short and uneven, little spikes at the front, bound with a thin grey ribbon. Body: thin and wiry, shoulders hunched. Clothing: a Luyện Khí outer disciple's simple graceful dress: a mulberry-grey silk robe with a crossed collar and a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe, the sleeves so long his hands vanish inside and the cuffs dark with spray, a faded blue fisher's neck scarf at his throat; as he pulls a sleeve back one wrist shows, grey to the wrist as if dipped in ash. Hands and objects: one grey hand holds a small stoppered clay jar of very dark ink against his chest. Power: a faint thread of dark violet qi coils near the jar, barely visible. Background: a blurred wooden jetty, a small boat with a round red-orange stern lamp glowing, dark sea with silver mist. Light: dusk spirit-light from the upper left, the lamp casting a warm spot, a cool rim on his hair. Expression: guarded and downcast, chin tucked, eyes slid sideways, lips pressed together as if keeping a secret; he is thinking of the winter storm.

people.imagined: At the stall, she has just spotted a customer's fat purse and her eyes have gone straight to it. The abacus bead at her neck swings. She is already counting.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a stall counter she glances at something below the viewer's face, as if at a fat purse, her eyes dropped, then flicks up with a quick sweet smile. Face: a sharp, pretty face with a pointed chin; light brown skin; quick, narrow, bright eyes; arched thin brows; a thin mouth with a faint smirk; a tiny dimple. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a red silk thread matching the cord at her waist, two strands curling by her ear. Body: slim, quick, leaning toward the counter. Clothing: a Luyện Khí outer disciple's simple graceful dress, new and closely fitted: a mulberry-grey silk robe with a crossed collar, a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe with narrow sleeves, a red cord at the waist; at her throat on a cord one big wooden abacus bead that swings. Hands and objects: both hands rest on the counter, the right holding a single copper coin between two fingers. Background: a blurred market stall with hanging paper sheets in lantern glow, a small girl with a broom a blur at the far end. Light: bright warm light from the upper left with a soft pearly rim on her cheek. Expression: sweet and greedy; the flick of her eyes to the purse is so quick a customer would miss it, and she is already counting.

people.imagined: On a path between the mill and the river, sitting on a stone to rest after twenty steps, braiding a hemp bracelet, happy.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a roadside stone between the mill and the river, resting after twenty steps, he braids a hemp cord and looks up at the viewer with an easy lazy smile; a dragonfly has landed on the stone beside him. Face: a pale, soft, narrow face; thin cheeks and light shadows under the eyes; gentle round dark eyes; a mild, slightly open mouth. Hair: black and loose, tied back at the nape with a hemp cord, a few strands on the forehead, one strand woven into the bracelet. Body: thin, narrow-chested, slumped. Clothing: a Luyện Khí outer disciple's simple graceful dress: a mulberry-grey silk robe with a crossed collar, a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe with the sleeves loosened, a pale silk rope belt tied in a loose bow. Hands and objects: both open palms show a red rope-burn band across each; his fingers weave a half-finished bracelet of pale hemp cord. Background: a blurred green riverbank, a rope bridge in the soft distance, drifting mist. Light: gentle afternoon spirit-light from the upper left, a soft golden haze about him. Expression: easy, content, unhurried; there is no worry on his face at all, only the slow pleasure of a day with nothing in it.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the dawn she first found her paintings held qi. A brush in each fist, the sky behind her head.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened; she stands with a long brush clenched upright in each fist, the dawn sky glowing behind her head like a halo, at the dawn she first found her paintings held qi. Face: a square, plain, strong face with brown skin, high cheekbones, thick straight brows, clear dark eyes looking straight out, a wide firm mouth and fine lines at the eyes. Hair: black, in a plain tight knot with two brushes thrust through it so they stand like two small antennae. Body: tall, broad-shouldered and vigorous, standing square. Clothing: the robes of a founder, ancient and noble: layered mulberry-grey silk with a dawn-gold brocade collar embroidered with ink-wash clouds, an over-robe of pale dawn-pink gauze with wide sleeves, the hem a little dusty from walking the shore, a stripe of grey paint along each cuff, a plain jade pendant. Hands and objects: a long brush in each hand held upright like two tall wands, both tips grey with paint. Power: a faint blue-green glow around the brush tips and a few motes lifting into the sky, the first light of her art. Background: a pale sky streaked with painted grey-white clouds and a rose dawn, the shore a dark stripe below. Light: dawn glow from behind spreading in a faint halo, soft silver light on her face from the upper left. Expression: fierce, absorbed calm, the gaze level and unblinking, a painter who has just seen her work come alive and will not say so.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the heavy, laughing co-founder looking away at the hills, a pearl-beaded merchant's cap on his head.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened; a heavy man in mid-laugh looks away toward distant hills rather than at the viewer. Face: broad, ruddy and round with a double chin, deep laugh lines, small bright eyes crinkled nearly shut, a big nose, a wide laughing mouth and a thin drooping moustache. Hair: black going grey, mostly hidden under a merchant's cap strung with a fringe of small white pearl beads that hang over his forehead and swing as he laughs; this pearl-beaded cap must be clearly visible. Body: heavy and big-bellied, relaxed, the round belly pushing the loose robe forward and the shoulders shaking with the laugh. Clothing: a co-founder's rich dusk-line dress: a loose, wide-sleeved robe of mulberry-grey silk with a dusk-violet brocade hem darkened where river water has splashed it, a translucent pale gauze over-robe unbelted, collars embroidered with ink-wash clouds, a jade pendant on his belly. Hands and objects: one hand rests on his belly; the other holds a loose rolled blank scroll lightly. Power: a faint blue haze of rain-qi drifts about him with a few pale motes. Background: pale washed hills under a pale grey curtain of rain, a pale grey bay beneath, faint lines of falling rain. Light: soft late-afternoon silver light from the upper left. Expression: a loud, idle, unbothered laugh, the eyes creased shut, a man at ease with the world and entirely sure it will pay.

people.imagined: Late afternoon at the scribes' desk. He is bent over the lord's war orders copying them and hears his name called; he straightens, left shoulder dipped from years of stooping.
people.subject: The moment: bent at a low writing desk in late afternoon, he looks up from his copying with his left shoulder noticeably lower than the right, the brush still held over the page, as he hears his name called. Face: a long, mild, narrow face; sallow skin; heavy-lidded patient brown eyes; thin straight brows; a long straight nose; a mouth closed in a small neutral line; faint ink on the chin. Hair: black, in a plain low knot with a wooden pin and a violet thread wound through it. Body: slim, with a visible stoop leaning to the left. Clothing: a Trúc Cơ inner disciple's dusk-line dress: a mulberry-grey silk robe of fine cloth, a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe with plain sleeves tied back, a narrow violet thread edging the hem and showing at the cuff, collars embroidered with ink-wash clouds. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a small brush above a sheet of blank paper with neat rows of tiny grey marks, no characters; the left pins the paper corner with a brass weight. Power: a faint blue-green haze at the brush tip. Background: blurred wooden shelves and rolled scrolls, a small oil lamp throwing soft motes of light. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left with a pale spirit-light rim on his stooped shoulder. Expression: loyal, patient, quietly sad, the eyes of a man who wants one thing and is not allowed to ask.

people.imagined: At a talisman contest she stands at her champion's shoulder, forearms folded, face still. She is grinding ink and has already decided the contest is lost.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a contest table with her arms crossed she looks level at the viewer and gives away nothing; her champion's ink is ground first, before her own, and the judge has just walked past without looking at either. Face: a plain, flat, broad face with a wide forehead; brown skin; small level dark eyes; thin plain brows; a short nose; a thick closed mouth; no expression lines. Hair: black, in a plain bun at the back of the head wrapped with a strip of grey silk and a pencil-thin brush stuck through it. Body: broad-shouldered and strong. Clothing: a Trúc Cơ inner disciple's dawn-line dress: a mulberry-grey silk robe of fine cloth, a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe pushed above the elbow to show thick, muscular bark-beater's forearms, brown and corded; ink-wash cloud borders at the collar, a plain grey sash. Hands and objects: her left hand grips her right elbow; at the table edge a stone ink dish and an ink stick worn short stand ready. Background: a blurred long contest table with sheets of pale paper in rows, a bright window with misty light. Light: even cool silver light from the upper left. Expression: stone-faced, resigned; her face does not move, and a faint downward tug of the mouth is all that shows she knows the contest is lost.

people.imagined: She is up before dawn without being told, wetting down a stubborn cowlick at the well, sunburnt to the elbows, and smiles at the first person she sees.
people.subject: The moment: in the dark before dawn at a stone well she pats a wet palm on the crown of her head to flatten a cowlick and smiles broadly at the viewer. Face: a round, open, sunburnt face with a peeling nose; big trusting brown eyes; thick brows; a wide smile with slightly crooked teeth; a few freckles. Hair: brown-black, a tuft at the crown sticking straight up despite the wet hand; the rest in two short plaits tied with undyed cord. Body: sturdy, short, a little clumsy. Clothing: a Luyện Khí outer disciple's simple graceful dress, new and clean: a mulberry-grey silk robe with a crossed collar and a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe with sleeves pushed to the elbow; her forearms are bright red with sunburn from the elbow down, lighter above, clearly two-toned; a plain brown silk waist-wrap. Hands and objects: one hand on her hair, a wooden water bucket on the well's rim beside her. Background: a blurred stone well under a pale grey pre-dawn sky, a single star, drifting mist. Light: faint cool blue light growing in the east from the upper left, a lantern hung on the well-post giving a small yellow glow on her cheek. Expression: cheerful, trusting and content; she has been up since the dark and her smile is slightly sleepy.

people.imagined: He walks the path from the spring with his eyes on the ground, his own hands and neck marked grey-brown with ink, thinking of the stones he sends home.
people.subject: The moment: walking a stony path with his head bowed, he lifts only his eyes to the viewer, shy and wary. Face: a thin, long, dark-tanned face with a heavy brow and a large straight nose; blotches of grey-brown ink staining one cheek and the side of his neck, plainly visible; small black eyes under a lowered head; a thin mouth. Hair: black, wild and unevenly cut, tied with a bit of cord, bits of dry moss clinging to it. Body: lean, wiry, shoulders hunched, half wild. Clothing: a Luyện Khí outer disciple's simple graceful dress, a little large: a mulberry-grey silk robe with a crossed collar and a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe; both hands and the neck above the collar blotched with grey-brown stains like thin mould. Hands and objects: both stained hands hold a rolled sheet of dark grey paper against his chest. Power: a thin black-violet shimmer lies on the stains, the faintest trace of Yin. Background: blurred grey limestone rocks and moss, the pale hollow of the Jade Milk spring under mist. Light: a pale blue spirit-light filters down from a gap in the rocks overhead, cool and dim from the upper left. Expression: shy, wary, reclusive; his eyes dart away if the viewer looks too long, and his shoulders hunch as if to hide the stains.

people.imagined: At the stall, on a quiet afternoon, he stamps a sheet and eavesdrops on the Counting House clerks at lunch. One brush behind each ear and ink on his cuffs, grin ready.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a stall counter on a quiet afternoon he grins easily, eyes turned a little aside as if listening to a conversation nearby, a stamp raised in his hand; two clerks at the next stall are talking about wages and he is memorising each word to sell it later. Face: a lively, narrow, freckled face; sharp chin; quick light-brown eyes; arched brows; a lopsided grin with a small dimple at the corner; a thin white scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: brown-black, short and messy, with a stub of charcoal tucked behind each ear, both clearly visible, almost worn to nothing. Body: slim, wiry, loose-limbed. Clothing: a Luyện Khí outer disciple's simple graceful dress: a mulberry-grey silk robe with a crossed collar and a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe, both cuffs smeared with black and blue ink, a cheap red neck scarf in a flat knot. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a wooden stamp with a round carved cloud on its face above a sheet of blank paper; the left rests on the counter. Background: a blurred market stall awning with hanging paper sheets, clerks in the distance, a bright gap in the awning showing blue sky. Light: warm bright light from the upper left, a soft glow on his freckled cheek. Expression: charming, sly, eager; his grin is open and friendly while his ears are tuned to the clerks.

people.imagined: Beside the mistress's desk at dawn, grinding ink, her head tilted toward a whisper, one finger pressed on the pot lid so nobody can look inside.
people.subject: The moment: at the mistress's desk at dawn she tilts her head sideways to catch a whisper from out of frame and presses one fingertip on the lid of an ink pot so no one can look inside, her eyes sliding to the viewer. Face: a smooth, pretty oval face with a small pointed chin; pale skin; narrow almond-shaped dark eyes that look sidelong; thin arched brows; a small tight smile; a tiny mole above the lip. Hair: glossy black, in a neat low coil with a silver pin shaped like a small crane. Body: slim, head cocked, shoulders turned inward. Clothing: a Luyện Khí inner disciple's simple graceful dress, crisp and spotless: a mulberry-grey silk robe with a faint violet edge at the inner collar, a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe, ink-wash cloud borders, the cuffs spotless in contrast to the stained sleeves of the others. Hands and objects: the first finger of her right hand presses down on the small round lid of a black ink pot; the left rests on a folded sheet at the desk edge. Background: a blurred desk with piled blank paper, a dim window, a door ajar, drifting mist. Light: cool dawn spirit-light from the upper left with a faint pearl rim on her cheek. Expression: attentive, falsely innocent, eager; a small practised innocence settles on her face while her eyes slide aside.

people.imagined: Beating bark at the mill, whistling two notes of a tune and never the third, glancing at Văn Tiểu Tang with a plot to swap jobs.
people.subject: The moment: whistling with pursed lips at the paper mill, he rests a wooden bark mallet on his shoulder and winks at the viewer; he whistles the first two notes of a song and skips the third, as he always does, with a plan to swap jobs. Face: a broad, round, ruddy face with a wide flat nose, small bright crinkled eyes, thick brows, pursed lips mid-whistle and sweat on the forehead, a flicker of conspiracy in the eyes. Hair: black, cropped very short, dry flakes of mulberry bark caught in it. Body: stocky, strong shoulders and thick forearms, the shoulder under the strap knotted with muscle from beating bark. Clothing: a Luyện Khí outer disciple's simple graceful dress: a mulberry-grey silk robe with a crossed collar, its hem dusted with pale pulp, a pale dawn-pink gauze over-robe with the sleeves rolled to the shoulder, a polished dark silk strap across the chest. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the long wooden bark mallet over his shoulder; the left, palm open and pale pink from the work, is raised in a half wave. Background: blurred wet bark piles and mill vats in sunlit steam. Light: bright misty morning light from the upper left, a soft glow on his sweaty brow. Expression: cheerful, easy and mischievous, the wink slow and the whistle breathy, the sly delight of a young man who means to trade his work for an easier job the moment the masters look away.
